title: feat(parser): resolve `use` imports to qualify call paths
problem: Detectors match on the literal receiver text, so an aliased import such as `use soroban_sdk::Address as Addr;` or `use crate::token::Client;` is not understood.
why: Accurate path resolution reduces both false positives and false negatives and unlocks detectors that depend on types.
scope: Build a per-file import map from `use` items, including `as` aliases and globs.
Expose a resolver on `ParsedSource` that canonicalizes a path string.
guidance: Keep resolution best-effort and syntactic; never attempt name resolution across crates.
acceptance: Resolver used by at least one detector
tests: Corpus fixture with aliased storage calls
security: Incorrect resolution could hide a finding; fail toward reporting when ambiguous.

title: feat(parser): inspect `cfg`-gated items and record conditionality
problem: Items behind `#[cfg(test)]` or platform `cfg` attributes are currently treated identically to always-compiled code, producing findings in non-shipped code.
why: Suppressing test-only findings reduces noise without weakening production analysis.
scope: Record `cfg` attributes on items and functions in the inventory.
Allow detectors to skip items gated behind `cfg(test)` by default, with a config override.
guidance: Extract the `cfg` attribute tokens; do not evaluate cfg expressions.
acceptance: Test-only code is excluded by default
security: Do not skip non-test cfg code by default except to avoid duplicate findings.

title: feat(parser): resolve workspace dependency versions and features
problem: A member using `soroban-sdk = { workspace = true }` records no version, so SS-015 and SDK-version reporting miss it.
why: Workspace inheritance is the common layout in production repositories.
scope: Read `[workspace.dependencies]` from the root manifest and resolve inherited versions for members.
Preserve the distinction between declared and inherited.
guidance: Correlate member manifests with the workspace root discovered during scanning.

title: feat(parser): map `mod` declarations to file-based module paths
problem: Module paths are derived from file locations, but `mod foo;` declarations that resolve to `foo.rs` or `foo/mod.rs` are not tracked, and `#[path]` attributes are ignored.
why: Accurate module paths improve report quality and future call-graph work.
scope: Follow `mod name;` declarations to their files, including `#[path = "..."]`.
guidance: Resolve relative to the parent module directory per the Rust reference.
security: Reject `#[path]` values that escape the crate root.

title: feat(parser): build a per-file function call graph
problem: Rules cannot follow a helper called from an entry point, so authorization or TTL performed in a helper is invisible to SS-001/SS-006.
why: Interprocedural awareness is the single largest source of false positives today.
scope: Resolve calls to functions defined in the same file and mark whether a helper transitively calls `require_auth` or extends TTL.
Expose helper summaries on the analysis context.
guidance: Do a bounded fixed-point over per-function facts; cap depth and document it.
acceptance: SS-001 and SS-006 consume helper summaries
security: Bound recursion to avoid pathological cost.
dod: Merged with reduced false positives documented.

title: feat(parser): expose doc comments as evidence
problem: Doc comments on functions and items are parsed as attributes but not surfaced, so guidance and suppression notes cannot reference intent.
why: Documented intent (for example `/// Permissionless: no auth required`) is useful context and can inform suppressions.
scope: Capture doc comments into the item/function inventory.
guidance: Extract `#[doc = "..."]` attributes into a joined string.

title: feat(parser): robustly associate source files with their crate roots
problem: Crate-root association uses the longest matching manifest directory, which is wrong for nested workspaces where an inner crate is not a workspace member.
why: Incorrect module paths degrade reports and any path-based logic.
scope: Verify membership against workspace `members` globs before assigning a crate root.
guidance: Record ambiguous associations as diagnostics rather than guessing.
